question: Seven people, I, J, K, L, P, Q and R are sitting in a row, facing north. Only J sits to the left of P. Only four people sit between J and I. Only K sits between R and Q. R is not an immediate neighbour of I. Who sits at the extreme right end of the line?
solution:
Seven people, I, J, K, L, P, Q, and R, are sitting in a row, facing north.

 
• Only J sits to the left of P.
 
• Only four people sit between J and I.
 
• Only K sits between R and Q.
 
• R is not an immediate neighbour of I.
